session_note: Arizona's 57th Legislature, Second Regular Session (2026) adjourned Sine Die on 2026-06-13 (roughly 4:45am), after a 153-day session. Bills not enacted by that date are dead for the biennium's second-year session; Arizona does not carry single bills forward into a new regular session. The official Bill Status Inquiry site (apps.azleg.gov/BillStatus) is a JavaScript single-page app that does not render usable content via plain HTTP fetch, so this pass relied on FastDemocracy and BillTrack50 (both of which mirror azleg.gov's own action-log data feed) for detailed chronological action histories; their own auto-generated 'status' summary labels were found to be unreliable (e.g. mislabeling withdrawn/dead bills as pending or enacted) and were NOT trusted -- only the underlying dated action-by-action history was used to determine disposition. Confidence is set lower than a direct legislature-page fetch would warrant as a result.
